subject: MCPB, how to treat protein-attached Ru-dye

messages.author: Matthew Guberman-Pfeffer
messages.body:
Dear Amber Community,
I’m wondering how to use MCPB to parameterize Ru(bpy)2(4-BrCH2-4’-CH3-bpy), where the Br is replaced by the S of a Cys sidechain?
Do I split the Cys residue, giving the sidechain to the Ru ligand and the backbone a new residue type?
I’d greatly appreciate any details of how to proceed.
Best,
Matthew

messages.author: Matthew Guberman-Pfeffer
messages.body:
Dear Amber Community,
I’m wondering how to use MCPB to parameterize Ru(bpy)2(4-BrCH2-4’-CH3-bpy), where the Br is replaced by the S of a Cys sidechain. Specifically, how do I define the parameters for the Cis-dye linkage? I know how to run MCPB for the dye by itself, but it’s the linkage to the protein that befuddles me.
Best,
Matthew
